name: Adapting to the humans the system works with
vision_statement: The AI system works in alignment with the humans it serves.
opportunities: Learning when to ask, per person, ordering what reaches the person so their scarce attention goes to what unblocks the most work, and translating priorities that are only implied, are opportunities beyond any risk watch: the same step may need a question for one person and none for another. Feedback can then change specs and metrics without a person repeating a correction.
solution_coherence: Consciousness is where the system adapts to the humans and policies it works for. Request Intake takes in what people ask through Intake Sources. Representatives are the AI personas that act for a person, carrying that person's authority, data scope, preferences and quality profile. Prioritization is the one place that orders three things for a person. The first is the work the system is about to start unasked, which Intelligence says is due. The second is the asks the system puts to the person, which arrive from Judgment Calls once it has decided to ask, so that the person's scarce attention goes first to what unblocks the most work and is not flooded. The third is the person's own goals, the solution milestones of their intents, which Intelligence keeps live, so that the system knows what the person cares about most. Prioritization also turns the priorities a person states or implies into ESOI. Judgment Calls decides for the person whether to ask, proceed or decline when a step is risky, and how the ask is timed. Feedback Learning proposes edits to specs and metrics, never to prompts. Those edits are applied directly, with no approval step, unless Judgment Calls decides to ask.
